column1: # RDKit-like aromaticity of externally supplied molecules that exposed
# perception defects during development (PubChem, Enamine and PL-REX records,
# plus the fused example from an RDKit source comment).
#   input        one connected SMILES component, or sdf:<file> in this directory
#   aromatic     aromatic atoms as source atom indices (ranges, "-" for none)
#   nonaromatic  bonds between two aromatic atoms that are not aromatic,
#                as lo:hi atom index pairs ("-" for none)
# Every other bond between two aromatic atoms must be aromatic, and no bond with
# a non-aromatic endpoint may be aromatic. Every row matches RDKit 2026.09.1
